name: BL Werewolf:Doki-Doki Summer vacation
detailed_description:
BL Werewolf is a werewolf game based on BL manga!

Set in a boys' high school dormitory during summer vacation, students from the "pervert camp" who want to eat straight guys and students from the "straight camp" who want to live peacefully live together while hiding their identities from each other.

Survive the "Devil's Week" when security is thin and protect your chastity from the perverts!

[Game rules]

The player's objective is to split into the "pervert camp" and the "straight camp" and earn points by achieving each goal.

Players in the "pervert camp" can earn points by satisfying their sexual desires by "night crawling" into straight guys and surviving the week. If they continue to fail at night crawling, their sexual desires will explode and they will go on a rampage, and they will be imprisoned.

Players in the "straight camp" can earn points by surviving the week as straight guys without being "night crawled" into by perverts.

[Discuss and find the pervert and suspend him]

The game is repeated five times (for five days) through three phases: day, evening, and night.

During the day phase, players discuss who is the most perverted, and can choose one person per day to suspend.

Suspended players will not be able to leave their rooms during the evening and night phases.

If you suspend the pervert successfully, you can prevent them from "night crawling," but if you suspend a straight guy, you will no longer be able to escape from "night crawling"...

[Deduce from the pervert's preferences!]

Each role has an attribute familiar from BL manga, such as "uke," "seme," and "riba."

The perverts in this game have their preferred attributes, and they cannot crawl into straight guys who do not have their preferred attributes.

You may be able to determine who is which attribute by using deduction!

Sometimes, you might find out some information by just assuming that someone is a bottom.

[Various roles]

There are roles with special abilities in both the "pervert" and "straight" camps.

For example, the "fudanshi", which is the equivalent of the familiar "fortune teller" in the Werewolf game, can find out the "bottom" and "top" attributes of other players.

There are also various other roles, such as the "macho" who can protect other players from night crawling, and the "discipline committee" who can ignore daytime votes and suspend players.

[Number of players]

BL Werewolf can be played with 5 to 10 people, and if there are not enough people, you can add CPU players to play. (However, the CPU players only act randomly.)
